rules.title: Mandate
rules.interpretation: Trade a configurable ETF wheel, default SPY. Changing the entry symbol preserves management of existing contracts and shares under their original identity. The investor is willing to own the selected ETF and wants recurrent eligible wheel exposure. Optional event uncertainty is disclosed; the trader obtains contract and premium evidence rather than requiring it from the researcher.

rules.title: Ownership
rules.interpretation: One nontrading researcher supplies compact dated evidence. Exactly one trading and risk agent selects contracts, quantities, prices and every order. Python only wires the shared attention runtime. Use Luna Medium via Login with ChatGPT for both agents.

rules.title: Coverage
rules.interpretation: Use max_contracts and max_collateral_pct of available cash for new put collateral, including costs and working obligations. Calls require unencumbered deliverable shares. No borrowing, naked options, automatic rolls or disposal of unrelated holdings. Defaults: one contract and 90 percent of cash.

rules.title: Contracts
rules.interpretation: New contracts MUST have min_dte through max_dte calendar days remaining inclusive, measured from today to actual listed expiration. Check the listed expiration with options_find_expiration and its returned calendar DTE before declaring no qualifying expiry. Compare at most three candidates near target_delta. One eligible returned candidate is sufficient; multiple candidates are not a prerequisite; describe the comparison as returned. Prefer call strikes at or above verified acquisition cost. Hold if none qualifies. Defaults: 30 to 45 calendar DTE and absolute delta near .25.

rules.title: Management
rules.interpretation: Accept expiry, assignment and call-away. Persist a favorable review when profit_capture_pct of actual gross opening premium is captured using the signed marked option value, before commissions. This observes a review condition, never an automatic close or a net-return claim. Before deciding to close, inspect the executable quote, opening and expected closing costs, and net proceeds. Reconcile fills, remaining orders and old-symbol exposure before re-entry. Default capture is 90 percent.

rules.title: Attention
rules.interpretation: Observe cheaply through session close. Free capacity: retain exactly one next eligible near-close entry opportunity; new entries only in the final entry_minutes_before_close window. Occupied by a short option or related working order: no entry/capacity-check timer under ANY review_scope. Retain meaningful profit, quantity and order conditions; reassess the qualitative ownership thesis at the holding review and add an event watch when it has a concrete observable invalidation. Keep one holding review within holding_review_days, and a dated pre-expiry review early enough for execution/recovery. After the pre-expiry review, unchanged expiry risk uses the existing position/order watches and at most one settlement follow-up, not repeated intraday clock reviews. Remove consumed/obsolete timers without deleting replacements. Inspect attention_list before finishing to confirm the actual saved phase plan. Reuse dated research for management; refresh only for a decision. Defaults: final 15 minutes, seven calendar days between routine reviews. Use the actual session close or disclose a reasonable approximation.

rules.title: Pricing
rules.interpretation: Use bounded limit orders and time_in_force. Inspect exact bid/ask and spread when available. Disclose historical trade-bar approximation; do not substitute future or current quotes. Smart limits are not the default.

rules.title: Validation
rules.interpretation: Qualification and performance comparisons are checks after execution, never permission to manufacture a trade or override the entry policy. Backtest results are simulated and do not promise future returns.
